review_type: bounded written source and theorem-contract review

items.title: Rational weight-three irrationality
items.parameter_range: coprime a,b positive; a<b; a/b<=1/2; log(a)/log(b)<1-2889/(352*pi^2)
items.status: Written complete proposed proof; no substantive gap identified in bounded review
items.scope_note: Includes b>a^6 and 2/65; does not include all rational q or q=2/3.

items.title: Inverse-parameter polynomial degree
items.scope_note: A_K=C_K*t^(-e_K)*Delta_K in Z[t,X]; deg_t<=deg C_K and deg_X=K; fixed-K limit is not a uniform K estimate.

items.title: All-weight real decay and real-target infinite nonvanishing
items.parameter_range: fixed integer s>=2; integer p>=2; q=1/p
items.scope_note: log|Delta|<=-log(p)*K^3/(3s)+O(K^2); this alone does not prove irrationality.

items.title: Exact square-family p-content and local infinite nonvanishing
items.parameter_range: s>=2,p>=2,K>=1 integers; every prime ell dividing p; every fixed X in Q_ell
items.scope_note: Exact p^e_K content; mixed parity signs required; naive s=1 extension is false.

items.title: Sharper general-weight denominator certificate
items.parameter_range: fixed integer s>=2; square H=K; integer p>=2
items.status: Written upper-bound theorem and certificate comparison
items.scope_note: C_s=(s+7/4+sum_{j>=1}(s+2j)^(-2))/pi^2; fits 1/2+1/(3s) only for s=2,3. Failure is not a true-denominator lower bound.

items.title: Varying-numerator content and local normality
items.parameter_range: s,p>=2 integers; arbitrary H,K for floor; H=K and w_0=1,w_j divisible by p^j for varying-numerator nonvanishing
items.scope_note: Nonzero subsequence uniform over numerator N(K); requires the stated coefficient divisibility.

items.title: Short-denominator certificate misses higher-weight budget
items.scope_note: Not a universal impossibility theorem; early-node numerators change moment range.

items.title: Positive tail determinant positivity and sharp analytic exponent
items.scope_note: Affine in target; positive every K; cubic decay 1/3; available denominator arithmetic fails.

items.title: Formal complete-block exact leading order
items.scope_note: Coefficient (-1)^(M*s*(s-1)/2)*((s-1)!)^(s*M); no fixed-p=2 asymptotic follows from formal order alone.

items.title: Uniform sufficiently-small-q complete-block exact cubic rate
items.parameter_range: integer s>=2; some q_s>0; all 0<q<=q_s; K=sM; arbitrary finite H>=0
items.status: Written uniform analytic theorem with internal audit
items.scope_note: Constants independent of K,H; threshold not shown to reach q=1/2; does not control arithmetic cancellation.

items.title: Fixed rational filters and finite dilations growth obstruction
items.parameter_range: integer s>=2; finite nonempty dilation set; nonzero rational-function coefficients; analytic at zero
items.scope_note: Rules out sum_{n<=N}|c_n|=O(N(log N)^nu) for each fixed nu>=0; does not rule out growing filters.

items.title: CRT numerator zero-or-large dichotomy
items.parameter_range: integral V(z,x), deg_x<=N, full cyclotomic congruences d<=N; integer j>=1,p>=2
items.scope_note: Symbolic condition gives product; fixed-p congruences give lcm. Neither lower-bounds signed determinants.

items.title: Disjoint-pole Loewner primitive equivalence
items.parameter_range: fixed union of 2K distinct reciprocal geometric poles; full K-dimensional bases
items.scope_note: Primitive polynomials identical up to sign; changing pole set or subspace is outside scope.

items.title: Explicit dual purity projector restores order-s poles
items.parameter_range: integer s>=2,p>=2; displayed s-shift Lagrange projector
items.status: Written purity identity and pole-order theorem
items.scope_note: Not a universal obstruction to every mixed/block projector.

items.title: Tall denominator additional common p-content
items.parameter_range: integer p>=2; odd s>=3; H>=2K-1; K>=1
items.status: Written content lower bound with internal audit
items.scope_note: Content at least p^(H(H+1)(K-1)/2 + sum_{i=1}^{K-1}(H-2i)ceil(i/s)); not exact content or nonvanishing.

items.title: Tall denominator available certificate and endpoint deficit
items.status: Written denominator upper bound and comparison
items.scope_note: At H=2K,s=5 budget 32/15 < high-index certificate contribution 24/pi^2; no all-coefficient extra-content formula for 1<H/K<2.

items.title: Two-weight rational linear independence
items.status: Written internally audited extension of baseline determinant lemmas; intended for later article
items.scope_note: 1,Z_2(p),Z_3(p) linearly independent over Q. Negative p pays 2^(K(K-1)). Does not add Z_1 or prove algebraic independence. Audit section 5 omits a plus sign in one display; correct sum appears in source and principal part.
